title: Fixture DSL v2 and metamorphic invariants
why_risk: tests and test tooling only; no engine code in this task
evidence: DSL v2 directives: bpm, samplerate, play/stop/reset, render N buffers|s buffer=M, clear events, expect event on|off|cc (port ch note vel cc val at len count absent), expect balance, track T mch V, step len/lenmul/all
9 new DSL tests (11 in the module), all passing on the unchanged 6ef921f engine at the DSL commit: they test the language, not the engine
tests/invariants.rs uses octocore's own Rng, no dependencies; 96 seeds per property, a failure prints the seed
buffer-size invariance and tempo-scale invariance are NOT added yet: they fail until O3 lands, and a failing test cannot enter the baseline. They arrive with WENGE-0003
unresolved: Two-key fixture mining and the corpus growth (Frontier 1) are later phases
